caption:
Your cost per lead went up. Three reasons, and one of them is you.

ONE — more advertisers are bidding for the same person than last quarter. An ad auction is a market. When demand rises and attention doesn't, the price rises.

TWO — your creative got tired. The same audience has seen the same thing too many times, performance decays, and the platform charges you more to keep showing it.

THREE, and this is the one you actually control — your offer stayed exactly the same while your competitors improved theirs. You are being compared, and you didn't move.

The first two are the auction. You manage them, you don't control them.

The third one is a decision you keep not making, and it's the one with the most room in it.

📌 Send this to someone blaming the algorithm for a number their offer is causing.
